description:
## What to do

Adapt the upstream tree navigation doc (tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/tree.md) for our Elixir system.

## Upstream source

- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/tree.md
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts (tree navigation)
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/compaction/branch-summarization.ts

## Output

Create docs/tree.md

## How to adapt

1. **Overview**: The tree navigation concept is the same. Document our `/tree` command.

2. **Comparison with /fork**: Keep the comparison table (fork vs tree) — it is technology-agnostic.

3. **Tree UI**: Convert the ASCII tree diagram to reference our entry types:
   - `[compaction]` instead of `[compaction: 12k tokens]`
   - Reference our `OctoPi.Coder.SessionManager` tree API

4. **Controls**: Convert the key bindings to our actual keybindings. Verify they match our keybindings.json defaults.

5. **Display**: Document our tree display format:
   - Height: half terminal height
   - Active leaf marker
   - Labels shown inline
   - Fold indicators (⊟/⊞)
   - Active path marker (•)
   - Filter modes

6. **Selection Behavior**: The behavior is the same:
   - User message → leaf to parent, message in editor
   - Non-user message → leaf to selected node
   - Root → empty conversation

7. **Branch Summarization**: Convert to our terminology:
   - `session_before_tree` event
   - `OctoPi.Coder.SessionManager.find_common_ancestor/3`
   - `OctoPi.Coder.SessionManager.branch_with_summary/3`

8. **Command Reference**: Document our `/tree` subcommands and options.

## What to preserve verbatim

- The tree navigation concept
- The fork vs tree comparison table
- The selection behavior rules
- The branch summarization concept

## Key upstream references to include

- [session-manager.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts)
- [branch-summarization.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/core/compaction/branch-summarization.ts)

## Testing the doc

After writing, verify:
1. All command names match our actual commands
2. All keybindings match our actual defaults
3. The tree API matches our SessionManager
